title: Pip's Listening Walk
note: b385 — first use of 'garden_gate'. P4's 'hidden in the hedge, only nose and eyes visible' is approximated as Moss peeking from the EDGE of a big bush rather than drawn half-hidden behind one (the kit has no partial-occlusion mechanism for a character), and p7's 'ghosted outlines of the sounds around the edge' is approximated with two low-opacity PROP ghosts (the gate, the rain) rather than ghosted cast members, since character opacity isn't piped through renderScene — only prop opacity is. See NOTES.

pages.brief: Wide garden dawn scene. Pip the sand-brown sparrow with a tufted head sits on the edge of the ivy nest above the shed, head cocked, one wing raised. Soft gold morning light, long shadows. Sound is suggested by faint pale ripples in the air, not by symbols.
pages.alt: Wide dawn view of the garden. Pip the small sandy-brown sparrow sits on the edge of his ivy nest above the shed roof, head cocked and one wing raised, soft gold morning light around him.

pages.brief: Close view of a weathered wooden garden gate swinging on a rusty hinge, Pip perched on the top bar bobbing with the movement. The hinge is drawn in detail — flaking paint, a bright worn spot. Pip's eyes are wide and delighted.
pages.alt: Close view of a weathered wooden garden gate swinging on a rusty hinge, with Pip perched on the top bar bobbing with the movement, eyes wide and delighted.

pages.brief: Corrugated shed roof from just above, fine drizzle bouncing off it in small bright dots. Pip shelters under the guttering, dry, watching. Cool grey-green palette so it contrasts with the gold of page one.
pages.alt: Close view of the corrugated shed roof with fine drizzle bouncing off it, while Pip shelters dry under the guttering, watching the rain.

pages.brief: Dark leafy hedge bottom, only a wet black nose and two bright eyes visible in the shadows. Pip peers in from outside, tail up, curious and a tiny bit unsure. Half the page is dark leaf shapes.
pages.alt: Pip peers into the dark bottom of a leafy hedge, tail up, curious and a tiny bit unsure, with only a glimpse of something hidden in the shadows.

pages.brief: Moss the berry-coloured hedgehog steps out of the hedge blinking, a single yellow leaf balanced on his snout, spikes flecked with dew. Pip hops back in surprise, wings half open. Warm and funny, not frightening.
pages.alt: Moss the hedgehog steps out of the hedge blinking, a single yellow leaf balanced on his snout, while Pip hops back in friendly surprise, wings half open.

pages.brief: Looking up the trunk of the old oak. Olive the plum-coloured owl on a branch far above, round and spotted, beak open mid-hoot. The whole garden below her drawn small and still. Emphasise the silence with lots of empty sky — a deliberately wide, distant view; Olive is meant to read small and far away here.
pages.alt: Looking straight up the trunk of the old oak to Olive the owl perched far above on a branch, beak open mid-hoot, with a great deal of empty sky around her.

pages.brief: Pip curled in the twiggy ivy nest with his eyes shut and a contented expression, evening light going pink behind him. Around the edge of the page, faint ghosted outlines of the gate, the rain, Moss and Olive — the sounds he is remembering.
pages.alt: Pip curled up asleep and content in his twiggy ivy nest, evening light going pink behind him, with the faint ghosted shapes of the day's sounds around the edge of the page.
